args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the spot-vs-contract gap.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, adding volatility to total freight cost.
• Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Saltmarsh Freight Blog + Companion: Three-Bullet Summary
